scope: iOS Safari simulator compatibility; not physical iPhone performance evidence; full controls run predates final runtime caching and mobile memory-budget refinements

harness.input: Native WDA touch events; event.isTrusted and pointerType verified
harness.sourceChanges: None; page-only observers capture rendered dash text, boost meter and runtime errors

checks.name: Production world initializes and title renders
Native Start reaches countdown and driving
Native hold and drag drive and steer
Landscape fits viewport and safe areas

limitations: Simulator uses host hardware and is not physical-phone GPU, battery or thermal evidence.
Correctness checks ran while other local verification work was active; no simulator frame-rate conclusion.
Production build exposes no dev hook. Driving speed read from the actual dashboard canvas draw calls, without mutating game state.
